_comment: Lucide icon names inlined into the site at build time by tools/build-icons.mjs. Keep this list minimal: every name here is inlined into data/icons.json (templates) and templates/schema-resume/js/vendor/icons.js (runtime). The site previously pulled the entire icon set from unpkg.com/lucide@latest on every page load. Note: Lucide carries no `github` glyph — brand marks were removed upstream over trademark, so links to the repository use `external-link`.
